Throughout DL6050, you will each be building a codebase for your deep learning methods.

## Setup & Tutorial

I've implemented the skeleton of this codebase for you here: [minDL](https://github.com/ds6050/minDL).
Your first task is to set this codebase up on your own, which is your [first assignment](assignment1.qmd).
